d: A wealthy businessman disappears from a five-star hotel.
A 5-year-old boy goes missing while his grandmother baby-sits.
The team searches for an escaped convict.
The team all face psychiatric evaluation, and Jess hunts for a missing legal secretary.

Things are increasingly hot and cold between Angel and Odalie as someone's keeping secrets; Collette hatches a plan to keep Rigo on the tour; Sage has an epiphany and pledges a new direction for his creative future.

Sage Odom revises his stadium tour into a grassroots movement with a purpose; things heat up between Rigo and Colette, but lies and doubts are constantly present; Odalie tries to keep Angel's affections.
It's a battle for control over High Water and dreams of power, fame and fortune; many secrets are revealed, including the real murderer of East-O and the true identity of Saint Clip.
The Calloways upgrade to a spacious new mansion; team owner Jimmy Flaherty attaches serious strings to Cam's max deal.
Cam and M-Chuck are scrutinized by a district attorney; Uncle Julius feuds with a neighbor who won't take responsibility for his dog's actions.
Cassie returns to the dating world and her determination to get what she wants sets her on a collision course with Cam; Reggie meets the peculiar and brilliant man who made Flaherty all his money.
Cam feels the pressure during his first game back in Boston; M-Chuck unearths lingering racial tensions during the family's cultural tour of a plantation.
Reggie meets a college football prospect with a troublesome manager; M-Chuck becomes involved in the life of a pregnant girl.
Chen attempts to woo Cassie at a gala to celebrate the launch of Cam's shoe; Cam makes a mistake with a reporter.
Lady Mae wants to preach at women's day, but Deacon Sykes is not convinced; Basie wants Jacob to run a new community center that will be built near Calvary; Lady Mae confronts Mavis.
The Greenleaf family struggles in the aftermath of Mac's release; Lady Mae makes a last-ditch attempt to save the Bishop; Basie's announcement opens a rift between the Bishop and Jacob.

Grace and Charity oppose Lady Mae's reaction to demands from the Deacon Board; the Bishop visits his father-in-law and runs into Mac; Kerissa and Jacob prepare to move out; Grace goes out with Darius Nash, a journalist following Calvary.
After one of Mac's victims attempts suicide, Grace makes a rash move that may have lasting consequences; Kevin's mother visits, exposing old wounds; Lady Mae tries to make Jacob see reason.
Two foes find themselves trapped together for a weekend under unlikely circumstances; Keyshawn reaches new heights, and Lil' Murda glows up big time.
